notes.title: Kickstarter for our new MIDI foot controller now live!
notes.content:
Our latest product, Poly Expressive, the MIDI foot controller that lets you control parameters with your feet, giving you a lot of the deep control that we're famous for but for controlling guitar pedals, amps and DAW is now on Kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1961989452/poly-expressive-midi-foot-control-dont-switch-cont
